title: Keel Infrastructure Liquidates Bitcoin Treasury in $192M Q3 Sale
summary:
The cryptocurrency mining firm formerly known as Bitfarms sold its entire stash of digital assets to raise capital for a transition into the artificial intelligence sector. Keel Infrastructure offloaded 2,520 BTC in the third quarter to fund a shift toward high-performance computing and stated it will now sell any bitcoin it mines on a daily basis.

The company is currently developing an AI data center in Moses Lake, which it says may be configured to support Nvidia's Vera Rubin architecture. Keel expects that the new infrastructure project will begin generating revenue in 2027.
